name: Equius Zahhak
source:
Equius Zahhak, also known by his Trollian handle centaursTesticle, is one of the trolls.

He is a complicated and somewhat disturbing troll. He is a firm believer in the blood caste system, believing one should respect those higher than them and be personally disgusted by those who are lower. He believes one is not only allowed, but obligated to boss around anyone who is lower-ranked than them and to accept and obey orders from anyone who is higher-ranked. Any deviation from this pattern flusters him greatly. He also likes to build robots, intending to destroy them in bouts of rage. He has an appreciation for fine Alternian "musclebeast" (horse) art that depicts extremely muscular and well-endowed beasts, displaying their brutish strength. He is freakishly strong and gets profusely sweaty when placed in compromising situations or when flying into rage fits.

His associated zodiac sign is Sagittarius. He is of indigo blood caste.

[From [url=https://mspaintadventures.fandom.com/wiki/Equius_Zahhak]MSPA Wiki[/url]]
